repos_data.description: MCP server for the Disney Lorcana TCG — card search, deck validation, deck stats, and Dreamborn/Pixelborn deck import/export for Claude and other MCP clients.
The first MCP server for the LitecoinVM ecosystem — 456K+ TCG products with on-chain Merkle proofs (USD prices frozen 2026-09-07; Japanese + graded panels refresh daily)
